Website design services

Professional Website Design That Turns Visitors into Enquiries

Kavitha Digital designs clean, fast, mobile-friendly business websites for companies in Chennai — planned around what your customers need to know before they call, WhatsApp or visit.

Get a Website QuoteCall 94459 78150

01Overview

Website design built around your customers, not a template

Your website is often the first conversation a customer has with your business. If it looks dated, loads slowly on a phone or makes people hunt for your phone number, they quietly move on to the next result on Google.

Our website design service starts with your business: what you sell, who buys it, which areas you serve and what makes people choose you. From there we plan the pages, write clear headings and design layouts that guide visitors towards one action — calling, sending a WhatsApp message or filling in an enquiry form.

Every design is responsive from the start, built to load quickly and structured for search engine optimisation, so the site is ready to be found as well as admired. Once a design is approved, our website development process turns it into a fast, secure live website.

Who it's for

  • New businessesLaunching in Chennai and needing a credible first website.
  • Growing SMEsOutgrown a basic site and want one that generates enquiries.
  • Established firmsNeed a redesign that reflects the quality of their work today.
  • Service providersClinics, consultants, contractors and studios who win work on trust.

02Problems we solve

Common website problems we fix

Most businesses that contact us already have a website. It just isn't doing its job.

It looks outdated

An old design makes a capable business look small or inactive. Visitors judge credibility in seconds, long before they read about your services.

It is hard to use on phones

Most local searches happen on mobile. Tiny text, broken layouts and buttons that are hard to tap send people straight back to Google.

It gets visits but no enquiries

Unclear headings, missing calls to action and buried contact details mean interested visitors leave without getting in touch.

Nobody can update it

Sites built on heavy themes, or by a developer who has moved on, become impossible to change — so information goes out of date.

03What's included

What's included in our website design service

A complete, practical package — not just a pretty home page.

Discovery and page planning

We map your services, customers and competitors, then plan a sitemap and page structure before any design work begins.

Custom page layouts

Distinct layouts for your home, service, about and contact pages, designed for your brand rather than a recycled theme.

Conversion-focused copy guidance

Clear headlines, benefit-led sections and calls to action. We can also write the words through our content marketing service.

Mobile-first design

Layouts designed for small screens first, then scaled up for tablets, laptops and large monitors.

Enquiry paths

Click-to-call buttons, WhatsApp chat links and enquiry forms placed where visitors actually need them.

SEO-ready structure

Logical headings, descriptive page titles, meta descriptions and internal links set up from day one.

04Benefits

What a well-designed website does for your business

A good website works for you around the clock. It answers the questions customers would otherwise ask on the phone, shows your work and makes the next step obvious.

Design is not decoration here — every section has a job, whether that is building trust, explaining a service or prompting an enquiry.

  • First impressions that build trustA professional look that matches the quality of your products or services.
  • More enquiries from the same trafficClear calls to action and easy contact options turn more visits into conversations.
  • A stronger base for marketingGoogle Ads and social media campaigns perform better when they send people to a focused, persuasive page.
  • Less time answering the same questionsServices, areas, process and FAQs explained clearly on the site.

05Our process

How we design your website

A clear five-step process, so you always know what happens next.

  1. Discovery call

    We learn about your business, customers, competitors and goals, and agree what the website must achieve.

  2. Plan and structure

    We propose a sitemap, page list and content outline for your approval before design starts.

  3. Design

    You review the home page design first, then key inner pages, with rounds of feedback built in.

  4. Build and test

    The approved design is built, tested on phones, tablets and desktops, and checked for speed and SEO basics.

  5. Launch and handover

    We connect your domain, submit the sitemap to Google and explain how future updates are handled.

08FAQs

Website design questions, answered

How much does website design cost in Chennai?

The cost depends on the number of pages, whether content writing is included, custom features such as booking or e-commerce, and how much design work is involved. After a short discovery call we share a written quote with a clear scope. Our guide to what affects website design cost explains the main factors.

How long does it take to design and build a website?

A focused business website with a handful of pages typically takes a few weeks from approved plan to launch. Larger sites, e-commerce stores or projects waiting on content take longer. We agree a timeline at the start and share progress at every stage.

Will my website be mobile friendly?

Yes. Every site we design is fully responsive and tested at real phone, tablet and desktop sizes. Read more about our responsive web design approach.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. We review what works on your current site, keep useful content and search visibility where possible, and redesign the structure and look. When page addresses change, we plan redirects so existing Google rankings are not thrown away.

Do I need to provide the content?

You know your business best, so we usually start with your input. If writing isn't your strength, we can plan and write the page content for you through our content marketing service.

Do you provide SEO after the website is built?

Every website launches with SEO basics in place. For ongoing growth in Google, our SEO services and local SEO cover content, technical improvements and Google Business Profile work.
